models.name: Duncan–Chang (1970), constant ν, endpoint-average
models.description: Original 1970 effective-stress, constant-Poisson, isotropic incremental 3D closure with project endpoint-principal averaging, maximum stress-difference history, explicit primary/equality/unloading branches and a positive numerical postfailure modulus. Compression-positive Mandel components; fixed spatial infinitesimal zero-spin frame; explicit stress/history preparation. Selected scalar cluster-average tie rows are not unique classical or proven whole-residual Clarke derivatives. Parameter examples illustrate source coefficients; no calibration, experimental validation, finite-rotation or arbitrary-path convergence claim.
